coordinate_system: Absolute raw source-image pixels; rectangles are [x,y,width,height]; points are [x,y].

body_height_basis.method: One fixed per-bank height, estimated from the closest-to-upright passing WALK pose at index 1. Vertical source-pixel distance from alpha>16 hair crown to projected midpoint of both boot sole contact centers. Axe, hands, and full-alpha bounding box height are excluded. This is a walk upright pose estimate, not an idle-sheet measurement.

alphaQA.source_edge_noise_note: Sparse source pixels of alpha=1 remain on some cell edges. They are below the alpha>16 meaningful silhouette threshold. Raw PNG was preserved unchanged.

visualQA.direction: Northwest rear three-quarter, elevated game camera
visualQA.two_hand_axe_carry: Correct hip/waist carry position; far hand occluded by torso, two-hand carry inferred
visualQA.pose_label_note: pose fields describe requested phase intent. Generated front bank has two visually similar pose families; alternating anatomical footfalls are not proven in every frame.
visualQA.walk_cycle_review: Opposing-leg changes are clearer than front. Left-column extension/right-column passing families remain similar; cadence and wraparound require in-game playback.
visualQA.framing_note: Generated sprites occupy more cell height than the requested head22%/foot82% guide. Metadata uses actual source landmarks rather than grid-center anchors.

provenance.full_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production transparent WALK sprite atlas, CH01 Luo Zhen / 罗砧, BACK direction.
Input images: Image 1 at C:/webdev/games/assets/generated/heroes/CH01_storybook_portrait_v1.png is the strict character identity and costume reference. Image 2 at C:/webdev/games/artifacts/design-reference-option3.png is the selected bright storybook adventure style, palette, elevated game camera and character proportions reference. Make a new full-body walking animation atlas from these references.
Primary request: A square requested 1024 x 1024 PNG with real transparent alpha, uniform invisible 2 x 2 equal cells, EXACTLY four separate full-body walking keyframes of the SAME adult male axe warrior. These four sprites are one animation sequence, not four different characters.
Character identity: handsome ADULT clean-shaven male, dark brown windswept spiky hair, NO helmet. Bright orange-red scarf trailing from his neck; charcoal/black armor with copper/gold trim and small orange accents. Strong adult proportions, matching anatomy and armor design in every frame. From the back we see layered back plates, dark brown hair back/crown, gold-trimmed shoulder armor, scarf from behind. Face mostly hidden, very small side-cheek if any, do not rotate face toward viewer.
Weapon: ONE large single battle axe, orange-black core with broad silver cutting edge, dark/brown handle and gold fittings, same reference weapon throughout the sheet. NO gun, NO hammer. BOTH hands hold the same axe neutrally at hip height at the FRONT of his body, partly foreshortened but axe blade readable to screen left. Stable carry, no attacking or swing.
Camera and facing: full body, true top-down three-quarter isometric game sprite camera elevated about 35 degrees. BACK facing northwest, diagonally toward screen LEFT and UP, we see his back and rear shoulders, looking away from camera. Maintain identical viewing angle and body scale in all four cells.
Frame layout, row-major: top-left frame 0 = LEFT leg leading toward upper-left, RIGHT leg trailing toward lower-right; top-right frame 1 = legs passing each other close at the ground plane; bottom-left frame 2 = RIGHT leg leading toward upper-left, LEFT leg trailing toward lower-right, visibly opposite leg forward from frame 0; bottom-right frame 3 = opposite passing pose. Four distinct readable walking keyframes; restrained shoulders/scarf motion. Stable torso/head height and axe position. Alternate walking strides, NOT idle duplicates, NOT running, NOT attack or jumping.
Composition: four equal invisible cells on a 2 x 2 sheet. In each cell sprite head crown near 22 percent cell height and projected boots midpoint near 82 percent cell height. Keep the FULL silhouette including entire axe inside a central 78 percent of each cell width; generous at least 40 source pixel transparent gutter at ALL cell edges. Each entire figure about 58 percent of cell height, no enlargement. Uncut boots, fingers, hair, scarf, axe; scales equal in all four frames. Exactly four separate poses, no extra figures or motion ghosts.
Style: refined hand-painted fantasy game illustration, crisp colored outlines and rich cel-painted shading, warm bright storybook mood and readable game-scale shapes. Match the adult hero and bright polished design reference. Warm highlights and saturated orange scarf; no photorealism, no plastic 3D rendering, no pixel art.
Background: true transparent alpha outside ALL sprites and in every gutter, NO ground, NO floor, NO cast shadow or boot shadow, NO scene, NO glow or effect, NO movement streaks.
Text: none.
Avoid: text, labels, grid, border, dividers, watermark, five or more poses, extra weapons, inconsistent costume, gun, hammer, helmet, beard, chibi/child proportions, front-facing face, facing screen right/down, orthographic flat front camera, any part crossing cell edges, opaque background.
provenance.image_processing: Pillow used only to read dimensions/alpha and measure bounding boxes. No pixel edits, resizing, compositing, or alpha cleanup.
